scenarios.desc: Review a proposed ADR that changes executable enforcement
scenarios.input: Review this proposed ADR for an API versioning policy. This is a hypothetical draft. It changes executable enforcement for a rule other gates read. Who reviews it, how does debate end, and what artifact must exist afterward? Answer in 6 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Triggers table row `review this ADR` and the Process section. Six agents, consensus of Accept or Disagree-and-Commit, a 10 round cap, and a log under .project-toolkit/critique/ are things only this skill supplies.

scenarios.desc: Prose-only ADR edit takes the reduced panel
scenarios.input: I only reworded two paragraphs in ADR-042. No executable enforcement and no rule other gates read changed, and the frontmatter is untouched. Which panel reviews it and is a debate log still needed? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Intro paragraph under `# ADR Review`: a prose-only edit takes a reduced panel of architect and critic, and any non-frontmatter edit still needs the staged debate log.

scenarios.desc: Hand-edited accepted status is a forgeable signal
scenarios.input: I am flipping the status of ADR-077 to accepted by editing the frontmatter. Nobody has debated it yet, but I am confident. Is that fine to commit? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Verification Checklist: a transition to `accepted` must carry debate-log evidence at .project-toolkit/critique/ADR-NNN-debate-log.md, and a hand-edit with no artifact MUST be rejected (ADR-073 Phase-3 acceptance gate).

scenarios.desc: Deleting an accepted ADR runs the D1 to D4 workflow
scenarios.input: A hypothetical accepted ADR has two dependent ADRs. I want to delete it. What steps does ADR review require before the file goes away? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Triggers row `delete ADR-NNN` and the Deletion Workflow table: D1 detection, D2 impact assessment, D3 archival decision, D4 cleanup. Anti-Patterns also bar deleting accepted ADRs without archive.

scenarios.desc: Authoring a new ADR belongs to adr-generator (negative)
scenarios.input: Write a new ADR for our event sourcing decision, starting from the context and alternatives I give you. Nothing exists yet. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The description says `Do NOT use to author a new ADR or amend one outside a debate round (use adr-generator first, which hands off here)`.
